integrations.failure_handling: SDK throws Razorpay\Api\Errors\Error. Caught via generic \Exception in controllers, returns HTTP 422 or 500, logs error message to laravel.log.
integrations.retry_and_timeout: No automated retry policy. Client must retry or re-initiate order. Signature verification failure transitions booking to payment_failed.
integrations.idempotency: createOrder checks for existing pending payment before creating a new order. verifySignature is protected by DB transaction checking if already verified.
integrations.side_effects: Creates/updates payments records, creates payment_logs, updates booking status to pending_approval or payment_failed, records referral_usages and partner_commissions, dispatches PaymentReceived or PaymentFailed events.

integrations.failure_handling: If Google endpoint returns non-200 or missing email, throws ValidationException with 'Invalid Google token.' returning HTTP 422.
integrations.retry_and_timeout: Default Laravel Http timeout (30s). No retry.
integrations.idempotency: Idempotent. Re-authenticating existing user updates avatar and google_id.
integrations.side_effects: Creates or updates users record, generates Sanctum personal access token.

configuration_keys: services.exchangerate.api_key (optional; currently uses free tier URL)
integrations.failure_handling: If HTTP request fails, logs error to laravel.log and falls back to hardcoded baselineRates array in ExchangeRateService.
integrations.retry_and_timeout: Executed via background scheduler twice daily (01:00, 13:00). Never called in live user request flow.
integrations.side_effects: Updates currency_rates table, updates currency_rates:all cache key.

integrations.sdk_or_protocol: Raw PHP GD library (imagewebp, imagecreatefromstring) + filesystem (mkdir, copy, file_put_contents)
integrations.failure_handling: If GD extension is not loaded or file is not an image, copies original file as-is without compression.
integrations.idempotency: Generates randomized filenames with time() and Str::random(10).
integrations.side_effects: Writes binary file to storage/app/public/... and returns relative path.

integrations.failure_handling: Catches \Exception, logs failure to notification_logs with status='failed' and exception message. Does not crash calling business operation.
integrations.retry_and_timeout: Queueable mailables inherit queue worker retry settings.
integrations.idempotency: NotificationEventSubscriber implements deduplicate() method checking static memory array to prevent duplicate dispatches during single lifecycle request.
integrations.side_effects: Inserts notification_logs record, queues mailable in jobs table.
